title: Pantheon IncidentCase
description: Canonical incident record. Attaches to RuntimeBinding, deployment stage, and lineage evidence. Write authority: Incident domain only. Formal lineage edge: incident_case.runtime_binding (binding_id → RuntimeBinding).

incident_id.description: Unique identifier for this incident (UUID recommended).

title.description: Short human-readable title for the incident.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the incident.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the incident was created (UTC ISO-8601).

resolved_at.description: Timestamp when the incident was resolved. Required when status is resolved or closed.

binding_id.description: RuntimeBinding reference — formal lineage edge incident_case.runtime_binding. The active or recently-retired binding at time of incident.

deployment_stage.description: Deployment stage at time of incident (denormalized from RuntimeBinding).

deployment_plan_id.description: DeploymentPlan reference — the plan that triggered the binding under which this incident occurred.

capital_pool_id.description: CapitalPool reference — the pool whose assets were affected.

persona_capital_binding_id.description: PersonaCapitalBinding reference — the governance admissibility proof linking the binding back to the persona.

artifact_id.description: The governed artifact that was executing when the incident occurred.

artifact_version.description: The specific version of the artifact under execution.

runtime_id.description: The LEAN runtime / container / worker process that was active.

trace_id.description: Trace identifier linking this incident to the telemetry event chain. Required by L1 traceability rules.

telemetry_event_ids.description: IDs of TelemetryEvents that triggered or are evidence for this incident.

reconciliation_ids.description: IDs of reconciliation records or DriftReports linked to this incident.

incident_cluster_id.description: Stable incident cluster used to dedupe repeated evidence for the same binding/runtime condition.

evidence_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the evidence collected at time of incident creation.

lineage_ref.description: Composite lineage reference (e.g. '{artifact_id}@{artifact_version}') for quick resolution.
